name: Size of Repeated-Coordinate Cubes
proof: The map $v\mapsto h_v$ is injective: each underlying bit is read by at least one coordinate. Its domain is the full n-cube, of cardinality $2^n$, so the class has exactly $2^n$ concepts.
references: Local definition-driven proof; bounded independent replay in sync/verify_noclashing_antichain_gap.py.
